title: Political Orientation and Participation in Prediction Markets: Large Stakes Converge, Small Stakes Diverge
abstract: arXiv:2611.29576v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Prediction markets offer a way to study collective expectations and beliefs: people express their views on various events and, by putting money behind their predictions, take on the risks of their judgments. As a result, the scale of investment can reveal additional dimensions of individual behavior and beliefs. In this study, we use a complex network approach to examine the structure of user participation, drawing on roughly 1.14 billion transaction records from the Polymarket platform, covering more than 3.1 million wallet addresses and 764,000 prediction events. To do this, we build a bipartite network of users and events and analyze patterns of investment concentration, connections between topics, and the network's community structure. translated_title: 政治倾向与预测市场参与：大额投注趋同，小额投注分化
translated_abstract: 预测市场为研究集体预期与信念提供了一种途径：人们对各类事件表达观点，并通过为预测投入资金来承担自身判断的风险。因此，投资规模能够揭示个体行为与信念的更多维度。在本研究中，我们采用复杂网络方法考察用户参与的结构，数据来自Polymarket平台约11.4亿条交易记录，涵盖超过310万个钱包地址和76.4万个预测事件。为此，我们构建了用户与事件之间的二分网络，并分析了投资集中度模式、主题之间的关联以及网络的社区结构。我们的发现显示，资金参与呈现高度偏斜的分布：1%的事件占总交易量的64%，而1%的钱包占总资金参与的79.2%……
tldr: 本研究基于Polymarket平台约11.4亿条交易记录构建用户-事件二分网络进行复杂网络分析，发现预测市场的资金参与高度集中（1%的事件占64%交易量、1%的钱包占79.2%资金参与），并揭示大额投注者在政治取向上趋于收敛、小额投注者则趋于分化。
en_tdlr: Using a complex network approach on roughly 1.14 billion Polymarket transaction records, this study reveals highly concentrated financial participation in prediction markets and finds that large-stake traders converge while small-stake traders diverge along political orientation.
